learning: Boundary checks on path strings using .startsWith(ROOT) are vulnerable to root deletion when inputs are empty or dot. Always use path.resolve() and append path.sep to the root boundary.
Free IP geolocation endpoints such as ip-api.com reject TLS on free tier (HTTP 403). Migrating away from cleartext HTTP (CWE-319) requires TLS-native endpoints like ipwho.is with fallback handling.

Electron safeStorage encryption fails before app is ready. Encryption and decryption routines must verify app.isReady() and safeStorage.isEncryptionAvailable() before attempting cryptographic operations.

insight: Stored pass-1 code_paths (main.js:968/2039/1657) drifted after ~800 added lines; re-anchor finding lines against the live tree before trusting them. Re-anchored to 1156/2325/1855 by direct read.

Desktop encryptSecret fix does not cover the Android Room proxyPass column; always audit the companion app/ tree for the same flaw class before calling CWE-319 closed. Android half still plaintext with no SQLCipher/EncryptedSharedPreferences.

Primary-handler HTTPS migration left resolveFallbackIpCountry on cleartext http://ip-api.com wired into 4 resolveIpCountry fallback sites. When closing CWE-319 transmission, grep the whole file for the endpoint, not just the handler.

Do not apply self_contained_blast to stolen-credential findings: proxy passwords are usable from anywhere (third-party resources, victim attribution). Also never copy a calibration checklist wholesale across findings with different attacker positions.

Shared entry point is not a chain: ad1e7679 (deletion) and 79d91e01 (credential read) are co-exploitable from one renderer-IPC compromise but neither satisfies the other's precondition, so no sequential chain was constructed.
